blocks.text: INN NEWS - Generation Z Indonesia, with their digital skills, is now an important power in politics.
Recently, they uncovered a scandal linking to an anonymous account "Fuffafa" in Cascus with Gibran Rakabuming Raka, son of President Joko Widodo and his rising political candidate.
This account is allegedly used to criticize political figures, including Prabwo Subianto.
This find is interesting because Gen Z's ability to investigate and verify information. The "Fufufafa" account went viral in days, sparking speculation about Gibran's involvement.
If these allegations are true, Gibran may face a major challenge in his political career, especially in relation to Prabowo who is also the candidate for vice president.
The power of Generation Z in politics stands out. They're using social media to demand transparency and accountability, which indicates the shift in political power in Indonesia.
This generation not only consumes information, it also significantly affects public opinion.
Gen Z has brought about a change in the way of politics in Indonesia with a more critical attitude towards political elite and more vocal voice.
It shows that the digital generation now has the power to affect public perception quickly and effectively.
If this case is growing, the role of Gen Z in scandal revealing can be an example of how digital power can change its traditional political landscape.
Their power in spreading information and forming public opinion becomes an important factor that politicians cannot underestimate.
To Gibran, this scandal shows that every action and word will be watched by the public, especially by a critical young man.
It's become a new challenge to keep clean political careers in the midst of accountability demands.
